## Install

1. Download **DisplayDial.dmg** below, open it and drag **DisplayDial** into **Applications**.
2. Open DisplayDial. macOS will say it can't verify the developer, because the app isn't notarized yet.
3. Go to **System Settings › Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**.
4. Click the ☀️ icon in the menu bar.

Requires an Apple Silicon Mac (M1 or later) running macOS 14 Sonoma or later. `DisplayDial.zip` contains the same app without the disk image.
